guarantees.claim: When sel_chk is not equal to MUX3_SEL_0, MUX3_SEL_1, or MUX3_SEL_2, err_o is driven to 1'b1 via the default case; otherwise err_o is driven to 1'b0.

assumptions.claim: MUX3_SEL_0, MUX3_SEL_1, and MUX3_SEL_2 are distinct and exactly the set of legal mux select values for sel_chk.
assumptions.risk: If any additional legal value exists but is not listed, err_o will incorrectly assert, creating a false error and potential denial of service.

uncertain_points.claim: err_o only asserts the error; this chunk does not gate any data path. An illegal sel_chk could propagate through the downstream mux before consumer logic acts on err_o.
uncertain_points.cond: When sel_chk takes an illegal value during operation.
uncertain_points.risk: Security-sensitive data (e.g., AES key material) may be misrouted, causing secret exposure or integrity loss before the error is contained.
